messages.author: 29ce8550baceaeb0
messages.subject: Use of plyr in shinyStan
parts:
I love shinyStan. I really love it. 

But I hate that it brings up plyr---especially now that everyone is using dplyr to make their code clean. I've lost quite a few hours trying to work out what the problem with my code is, only to discover that group_by() or summarise() have been masked by plyr. I'd be happy to chip in some time to help get rid of the dependencies, but am not very familiar with the source code. How difficult a job would it be?

messages.author: c4d395346152354a
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Use of plyr in shinyStan
parts:
I haven't seen the actual source code. But I suspect the simplest fix would be to not import plyr and use the plyr::group_by() syntax to make he actual function calls.

Typed with opposable thumbs.
